description: NaBi₃(O₂Cl)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Amm2 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaBi₃(O₂Cl)₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O and four Cl atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.36 Å. There are two shorter (3.27 Å) and two longer (3.33 Å) Na-Cl bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.22 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.24 Å. In the third Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Bi-O bond lengths are 2.24 Å. O is bonded to one Na and three Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaBi₃ tetrahedra. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na atoms.
